paragraphs.text: Gloom was a spirit from an unknown plane .

She was a ghostly companion of Noranda-Zang . She was normally invisible but could turn visible at will. Fetid gases billowed from her when she moved, casting a choking smell. Her evil and bloodthirst were readily apparent when she spoke, eagerly hissing for the death of Thane Du-Moriss IV 's wife, Bayende . On Zang's orders, she scoured the flesh from Bayende's bones, eating her unborn child.
